372	// Matches checks if a node matches the filter criteria
373	func (nf *NodeFilter) Matches(node *objects.DVENode) bool {
374		if nf.Status != "" && node.Status != nf.Status {
375			return false
376		}
377		if nf.TEEType != "" && node.TEEType != nf.TEEType {
378			return false
379		}
380		if nf.Location != "" && node.Location != nf.Location {
381			return false
382		}
383		if nf.MinStake > 0 && node.StakeAmount < nf.MinStake {
384			return false
385		}
386		if nf.MinReputation > 0 && node.ReputationScore < nf.MinReputation {
387			return false
388		}
389		// Check capabilities
390		if len(nf.Capabilities) > 0 {
391			nodeCapMap := make(map[string]bool)
392			for _, cap := range node.Capabilities {
393				nodeCapMap[cap] = true
394			}
395			for _, reqCap := range nf.Capabilities {
396				if !nodeCapMap[reqCap] {
397					return false
398				}
399			}
400		}
401		return true
402	}

799				var processCount int
800				for _, s := range stats {
801					totalCPUTime += s.CPUTimeNs
802					processCount++
803				}
804				if processCount > 0 {
805					avgCPUTimeNs := float64(totalCPUTime) / float64(processCount)
806					return avgCPUTimeNs / 1_000_000.0
807				}
808			}
809		}

820		dm.mu.RLock()

822		dm.mu.RUnlock()
823	
824		if ebpfMgr != nil {
825			stats, err := ebpfMgr.GetProcessMetrics()
826			if err == nil && len(stats) > 0 {
827				var totalContextSwitches uint32
828				var totalPageFaults uint32
829				var processCount int
830				for _, s := range stats {
831					totalContextSwitches += s.ContextSwitches

---

**Root cause:** When a DVE is initialized via either HTTP endpoint (`POST /api/dve-creation/nodes` or `POST /api/dve-nodes`), the backend stored the node in the database but never emitted a WebSocket event. The frontend hooks listen for `dve-node-discovered` and `dve-node-updated` to trigger real-time refreshes, so they never fired on creation — the UI only updated when the 15-second polling interval fired.

**Changes made (3 files, clean build confirmed):**

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `internal/web/dve_handlers.go` | Added `wsBroadcaster` interface + field + setter; broadcasts `dve-node-discovered` on node register, `dve-node-updated` on node update |
| `internal/web/dve_creation_handlers.go` | Added `wsBroadcaster` field + setter; broadcasts `dve-node-discovered` after `CreateDVE` succeeds |
| `cmd/backend_server/main.go` | Wired `s.websocketService` into both handler instances (the normal route block and the unified API router block) |

Now when you initialize a DVE, the frontend will receive a `dve-node-discovered` event immediately and refresh the list in real-time.
